name: fake-3d-image
title: Fake 3D Image
description: OGL depth-map parallax effect — move the cursor to shift the image by a grayscale depth map.

usage.label: Astro
usage.code:
---
import "@/components/motion-kit/fake-3d-image-element.ts";
---

<motion-fake-3d-image
  color-src="/path/to/image.jpg"
  depth-src="/path/to/depth-map.jpg"
  x-threshold="8"
  y-threshold="8"
  sensitivity="0.25"
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

usage.label: React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/fake-3d-image-element.ts";
</script>

<template>
  <motion-fake-3d-image
    color-src="/path/to/image.jpg"
    depth-src="/path/to/depth-map.jpg"
    :x-threshold="8"
    :y-threshold="8"
    :sensitivity="0.25"
    class="w-full h-[400px]"
  />
</template>

usage.label: Svelte
usage.code:
<script>
  import "@/components/motion-kit/fake-3d-image-element.ts";
</script>

<motion-fake-3d-image
  colorSrc="/path/to/image.jpg"
  depthSrc="/path/to/depth-map.jpg"
  xThreshold={8}
  yThreshold={8}
  sensitivity={0.25}
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

usage.label: HTML
usage.code:
<script type="module" src="/components/motion-kit/fake-3d-image-element.js"></script>

<motion-fake-3d-image
  color-src="/path/to/image.jpg"
  depth-src="/path/to/depth-map.jpg"
  x-threshold="8"
  y-threshold="8"
  sensitivity="0.25"
  class="w-full h-[400px]"
/>

props.name: color-src
props.description: URL of the color image to display.

props.name: depth-src
props.description: URL of the grayscale depth map (white = near, black = far).

props.name: x-threshold
props.description: Parallax strength threshold on X axis.

props.name: y-threshold
props.description: Parallax strength threshold on Y axis.
